name: Essential
summary: Clean white skincare store with a calm book-serif voice, centered product hero and soft nature-styled product photography in pale grey frames.

fonts.pairing: medium-weight bookish serif headlines, friendly geometric sans at 500 for all body and UI

signature: two-line centered serif headlines with the second line in mid grey, repeated through the page
an arch of circular product thumbnails framing a centered stat headline
sticky feature rows: label chip, serif title and copy on the left, two framed image cards on the right
imagery: styled skincare still lifes on botanicals, creams and stones, soft daylight, sage, sand and cream tones
layout_grid: 1200px frame inside a 1440px max, 40px side padding, 100px section padding, 52px header gap, 16px radius cards on #f8f8f8
